reads_against: Priced at 541.0x post-issue earnings against a 52x median for its 3 listed peers — a premium of more than 30%, which the business has to earn before the listing does.
Net margin is 1.07%. A high-volume, low-margin model: a small move in input costs or realisations swings profit far more than it swings revenue.
More of the issue is existing holders selling (₹518 Cr) than new money into the business (₹150 Cr).
Return on capital employed is 1%. Below about 8% the business earns less on its capital than it costs to carry, so growth consumes value rather than adding it.
